tile.name: JS Paint
tile.desc: A remake of MS Paint, in the browser

addon.title: JS Paint
addon.summary: Isaiah Odhner's remake of MS Paint, running in the visitor's browser. It paints with the classic tools and palettes, and saves PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF and SVG to the device. It autosaves the current picture in this browser. It needs about 18 MB of storage. It is English only; PDF import and head tracking are not included. It makes no requests outside the box and has no online sessions or Imgur upload.
addon.consent: This downloads JS Paint from github.com/1j01/jspaint at the commit that this hub pins. A new web add-on starts disabled. After you enable it, the hub serves it to the visitors that its Access setting lets open it. The copy is adapted for the box: online multi-user sessions and Imgur upload are removed, English is the only language, PDF import and head tracking are left out, and a strict Content-Security-Policy stops every request outside the box. Pictures stay in the visitor's browser unless they save one to their device. Add JS Paint?
